description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bogahawewa, Nochchiyagama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110278 (23/0596)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their locations, extents, ownership details, and nature of title. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, including declarations of title determinations for multiple land parcels in various villages, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
